mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation exceeds 4.0%, the market anticipates prolonged monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL y/y > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in labor market strength (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% m/m) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 4.0% y/y) signals an overheating economy, prompting aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% m/m AND CPIAUCSL > 4.0% y/y
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both PAYEMS growth > 0.5% m/m and CPIAUCSL > 4.0% y/y.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts below 1350 thousand units signals weakening demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1350 during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in industrial production above 102.0 index signals robust economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 102.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, the labor market is perceived as excessively tight, fueling inflation expectations and prompting aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP below 2.0% annualized growth rate signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% within the past 5 trading days compresses short-term equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.25%.
